text: Walk us through the house, the garage, the yard — point at anything and everything. We size it up at the onsite estimate and hand you one clear, price. No obligation attached.

items.title: 3. Put Your Feet Up
text: Approve the quote and our crew takes over completely. Down the stairs, through the hallway, out the door — every item travels on our shoulders, not yours, with your home protected the whole way.

items.title: 4. We, Sort and Send It On
text: The space gets tidied before we leave, and your items get sorted after: donation centres take what still works, recyclers take the metals and electronics, and the landfill only sees what nothing else will.

items.q: Q: What will it cost to remove junk from my Bradford home?
a: A: The truck decides. Pricing is based purely on how much space your items occupy — starting at {{min_price:C}} for a 1/16 Junk Load (1 cubic yard) — and the exact figure is confirmed with a free quote at your door before anything is touched.
A: Usually, yes. Call +1 647 922 5865 and we’ll tell you honestly what’s available right now.

items.q: Q: Do I have to drag everything to the curb first?
a: A: Please don’t — carrying is literally what you’re paying us for. Tell us where things sit, whether that’s an upstairs bedroom, a cold cellar or the back corner of a shed, and our crew brings them out while protecting your floors and doorframes the whole way.

items.q: Q: Is one item worth booking, or do you have a minimum?
a: A: One item is absolutely worth it. A lone mattress or fridge is priced as the small load it is — a fraction of a full truck — with no minimum-load penalty inflating the bill. Single-item runs make up a big share of our Bradford schedule.

items.q: Q: We're in a rural spot outside town — do you come out this far?
a: A: Yes. Farm properties, Marsh-area addresses and long laneways are part of our normal Bradford routes, and distance never changes your volume-based price.
